text:
The Status of the Strait of Hormuz Will Not Return to Pre-War Conditions

Reports on the details of the "potential" initial agreement between Iran and the United States indicate that, should this agreement be finalized, the "status of the Strait of Hormuz" will not revert to its
translated_text:
霍尔木兹海峡的现状不会回到战前状态

关于伊朗和美国之间“潜在”初步协议细节的报道表明，如果该协议最终敲定，“霍尔木兹海峡的地位”将不会恢复到原来的状态。

text:
In this manner, Iran emphasizes the exercise of its sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz through various means, the details of which will be announced.

Additionally, the maritime siege must also be completely lifted within 30 days in accordance with the agreement.
translated_text:
伊朗以此方式强调通过多种方式对霍尔木兹海峡行使主权，具体细节将另行公布。

此外，海上封锁也必须按照协议在30天内彻底解除。

text:
If the maritime blockade is not lifted, there will be no change in the Strait of Hormuz.

Moreover, implementing changes in the passage through the Strait of Hormuz is also contingent upon the execution of other U.S. commitments in the memorandum of understanding.
translated_text:
如果海上封锁不解除，霍尔木兹海峡不会有任何变化。

此外，霍尔木兹海峡通道的改变还取决于美国在谅解备忘录中其他承诺的执行情况。

text:
Part of Iran's frozen assets must be released in the first step

Reports on the details of the "possible" initial agreement between Iran and the United States indicate that, should this agreement be finalized, part of Iran's frozen assets must be released in the first step.
translated_text:
第一步必须释放伊朗被冻结的部分资产

关于伊朗和美国之间“可能”达成的初步协议细节的报道表明，如果该协议最终敲定，伊朗被冻结的部分资产必须首先释放。

text: Reports indicate that the United States has been attempting in recent weeks to tie the release of these assets to a potential final agreement on the nuclear issue, but Iran has emphasized that at least a portion of them must be released right at the outset of the preliminary
translated_text: 有报道称，美国最近几周一直试图将这些资产的释放与核问题的潜在最终协议挂钩，但伊朗强调，至少其中一部分必须在初步协议一开始就释放。

text: While the mechanism for releasing the remaining portion must also be clarified during the course of negotiations, and in the event that the Americans obstruct the release once again, Iran will revise its position in future negotiations.
translated_text: 而剩余部分的释放机制也必须在谈判过程中明确，如果美国再次阻挠释放，伊朗将在未来的谈判中改变立场。

text:
The waiver of Iran's oil sanctions during the negotiation period is one of the clauses of the potential agreement.

Reports on the details of the initial "potential" agreement between Iran and America indicate that Washington will commit to waiving Iran's oil sanctions during the
translated_text:
谈判期间放弃伊朗石油制裁是潜在协议的条款之一。

有关伊朗和美国之间初步“潜在”协议细节的报道表明，华盛顿将承诺在伊朗石油制裁期间放弃对伊朗的石油制裁。

text: An understanding in which the end of the war across all fronts, including Lebanon, is also emphasized. The Zionist regime, based on this clause as an ally of America, must also end the war in Lebanon.
translated_text: 其中还强调了包括黎巴嫩在内的所有战线战争的结束。基于这一条款，犹太复国主义政权作为美国的盟友，也必须结束黎巴嫩战争。

text:
Following that, a 30-day period has been envisioned for implementing measures related to the maritime blockade and the Strait of Hormuz, and simultaneously, a 60-day period for negotiations on the nuclear issue will be defined.

Iran has not accepted any actions in the nuclear
translated_text:
此后，预计实施海上封锁和霍尔木兹海峡相关措施的期限为30天，同时将确定核问题谈判的期限为60天。

伊朗尚未接受任何核行动

text:
Property Ownership Claim Registration System Launched

All individuals whose properties and lands are held via informal agreements have 2 years to upload their documents to obtain official title deeds.

text:
Suicide of Another Zionist Army Soldier After Returning from the Gaza War

Alex Miller, who had a history of participating in the war against the Gaza Strip, was struggling with severe psychological problems after the end of his presence on the battlefield.
translated_text:

text:
Macron's consultations with Trump and Gulf countries' leaders for an agreement with Iran

The President of France, in separate conversations with Trump and the leaders of the Gulf countries, has called for achieving a diplomatic solution and an agreement with Iran.
translated_text:

text: BREAKING: A suspect was shot and killed after opening fire on a Secret Service checkpoint, officials say.
translated_text: 突发新闻：官员称，一名嫌疑人向特勤局检查站开枪后被枪杀。

text: NEW: Suspect opened fire on Secret Service security booth, sources say, but no agents wounded
translated_text: 新消息：消息人士称，嫌疑人向特勤局安全亭开枪，但没有特工受伤

text: UPDATE: Two people were shot, including the suspect, law enforcement sources say. The White House lockdown is lifted.
translated_text: 更新：执法部门消息人士称，两人被枪杀，其中包括嫌疑人。白宫封锁解除。

text: BREAKING: Apparent gunshots heard outside the White House on Saturday. CBS News'@aaronlarnavarroreports on what we know so far.
translated_text: 突发新闻：周六，白宫外听到明显的枪声。哥伦比亚广播公司新闻@aaronlarnavarro 报道了我们目前所知的情况。

text:
BREAKING: What sounded like possible gunfire was heard near the North Lawn of the White House Saturday evening, multiple CBS News reporters said.

Approximately 20 shots were heard just after 6 p.m. Eastern Time. They appeared to be coming from the side of the White House complex
translated_text:
突发新闻：多名哥伦比亚广播公司新闻记者称，周六晚上，白宫北草坪附近听到了听起来可能是枪声的声音。

下午6点刚过，大约听到20声枪响。东部时间。他们似乎来自白宫建筑群的一侧

text: USSS tells@CBSNewsthey are aware of reports of shots fired near 17th Street and Pennsylvania Avenue NW and are working to corroborate the information with personnel on the ground. via@saraecook
translated_text: USSS 告诉@CBSNews，他们已获知有关第 17 街和宾夕法尼亚大道西北附近发生枪击事件的报道，并正在努力与地面人员核实该信息。通过@saraecook

text:
Tons (20-30) of shots were heard outside the White House grounds. 

We ran from our liveshot locations into the briefing room. USSS agents are outside the door and are on the north lawn.
translated_text:
白宫场地外听到大量（20-30）声枪响。 

我们从现场拍摄地点跑进简报室。 USSS 特工就在门外和北草坪上。

text: The suspect in the shooting outside White House is dead,@gabrielle_akereports.
translated_text: 白宫外枪击案的嫌疑人已经死亡，@gabrielle_akereports。

text: UPDATE: Two hit by gunfire outside White House — the suspect and a possible bystander — and taken to hospital. Suspect in critical condition, second person in serious condition. US Secret Service agents were apparently shot at and returned fire at 17th and Penn. No agents
translated_text: 更新：两人在白宫外遭到枪击——嫌疑人和可能的旁观者——并被送往医院。嫌疑人情况危急，第二人情况严重。美国特勤局特工显然在 17 街和宾夕法尼亚大学遭到枪击并还击。没有代理

text: I was in the middle of taping on my iPhone for a social video from the White House North Lawn when we heard the shots. It sounded like dozens of gunshots. We were told to sprint to the press briefing room where we are holding now.
translated_text: 当我们听到枪声时，我正在白宫北草坪用 iPhone 录制社交视频。听起来像是数十声枪响。我们被告知要冲向我们现在所在的新闻发布会室。

text: BREAKING: President Trump says a peace deal with Iran has been “largely negotiated” and “will be announced shortly.”
translated_text: 突发新闻：特朗普总统表示，与伊朗的和平协议已经“基本通过谈判”，并且“将很快宣布”。

text: First reaction from President Trump on the shooting outside of the White House Saturday night.
translated_text: 特朗普总统对周六晚间白宫外枪击事件的第一反应。

text: When I asked USSS tonight for an update on the bystander they told me that they “don’t have any update other than he was in surgery earlier.”
translated_text: 当我今晚向 USSS 询问有关旁观者的最新情况时，他们告诉我，“除了他早些时候接受手术外，他们没有任何更新。”

text:
I am closely monitoring the shooting incident near the White House and will update the public as we have more information. 

Tonight’s shooting is a reminder of the dangers our law enforcement officers face every day. 

I am thankful for the bravery and swift action of the
translated_text:
我正在密切关注白宫附近的枪击事件，并将在获得更多信息后向公众通报最新情况。 

今晚的枪击事件提醒我们执法人员每天面临的危险。 

我对政府人员的勇敢和迅速行动表示感谢

text:
Evidence markers are placed on the ground at the corner of Pennsylvania Avenue NW and 17th Street NW after multiple rapid-fire gunshots ring out outside the White House Saturday evening.
 
President Trump was reportedly inside the White House working on a peace deal with Iran.
translated_text:
周六晚上，白宫外响起多声连发枪声后，宾夕法尼亚大道西北和第十七街西北拐角处的地面上放置了证据标记。
 
据报道，特朗普总统正在白宫内致力于与伊朗达成和平协议。

text: The suspect who pulled a weapon from his bag and began firing at U.S. Secret Service near the White House is confirmed dead, per U.S. Secret Service.
translated_text: 据美国特勤局称，从包里掏出武器并开始向白宫附近的美国特勤局开枪的嫌疑人已确认死亡。

text:
President Trump still working in the White House tonight. 

He was in DC this weekend but safe inside the WH.
translated_text:
特朗普总统今晚仍在白宫工作。 

他本周末在华盛顿，但在白宫内很安全。
